Method of Attack: Sabotaging performance monitoring operations for the two affected services, Dnsclient and RpcEptMapper, to mitigate privilege escalation
Exploiting insecure permissions on registry keys of RpcEptMapper and DnsCache services to load malicious DLLs and execute arbitrary code with LOCAL SYSTEM permissions
Attack Vector: Local attacker exploiting misconfigured service registry keys RpcEptMapper and DnsCache
Local non-admin user creating Performance subkey and triggering performance monitoring to load malicious DLL
